name: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
description: omp-slim: a custom Pi build focused on frequently used oh-my-pi features

scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs executable dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: bun run --cwd ../tui build && bun run --cwd ../telemetry build && bun run --cwd ../ai build && bun run --cwd ../agent build && bun run build && bun build --compile --minify --production --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts ./src/core/tools/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/omp-slim && bun run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/modes/interactive/theme && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/modes/interactive/assets && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/core/export-html/vendor
scripts.copy-binary-assets: bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs examples ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "../../node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-natives-*/pi_natives.*.node" dist && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/theme && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/assets && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html && bun ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/export-html/vendor
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build

author: Mario Zechner
